owner_direction: Two weapons for core game; remove the third slot, no unlock planned; pressure and higher stakes through loadout commitment. Owner asks for our own design judgment, not another game as a reference.
implementation: Purchases/finds replace selected carried gun, compare-before-confirm; keyboard 1/2 equip; 3 is only an opening offer choice. Server rejects retired-slot purchase/equip requests.
limits: Historical opt-in isolated legacy combat fixtures retain old two-primary setup. Normal play, normal setup, economy and new co-op checks use the one-primary limit. No new gun balance, ammo rewards or upgrade-loss policy.
